title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod). [Curation 2026-08-18 (AGT-2671): stays current as a standing rolling log, not a single-decision dossier. The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" are not part of the descriptor vocabulary and made this Dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; corrected to active/informational, matching the same mapping used for the other standing-reference dossiers (admin-design-guideline, nordstern). No related task key is fully terminal yet, so it is not closable.]
